rows.claim: The incident dungeon's exit gate is a produced restatement of the four real defect classes, so demonstrated learning is the win condition, not reaching a door.

rows.quote: Rolls are committed BEFORE the actor speaks. The DM may not override a roll, may only narrate its consequence.
rows.steal: One sitting: bind st.sb from rollStatBlock in loadLevel, fix the def scoping at ruins_go_engine.js:348, and route contact outcomes through OracleDice with hp consumption to give the engine its first real combat loop.
rows.falsifier: Any narrator path that rerolls or post-hoc reinterprets a committed roll falsifies the law; likewise a wired trait that does not change the snake/lizard state graph proves the layer is still decorative.
